judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names: it used `list_sessions`, `session_list` with a `sessions` field, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, and `SessionSummaryFrame` instead of the ticket's explicitly required `list_conversations`, `conversation_list` with `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, and `ConversationCursor`. It also made `sessionStore` a required parameter in `createMessageHandler(orchestrator, sessionStore, history)`, breaking existing 1-arg callers and tests. Furthermore, it logs `(error as Error).message` on store failures (which can leak database credentials, whereas the spec/reference logs error type and sessionId) and commits a temporary `.lore/dod.md` file. Several explicit acceptance criteria were completely omitted, including `StoreCannotList`, startup warnings when `history` is enabled without `resume`, updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, and tests for streaming lock bypass and session resume integration.
